node.statement: GT-munkres-edt-thm-10.6 states, in the OCR notation visually reconciled in the registry shard, that if M is a non-bounded C^r manifold then M has a C^r triangulation. Node 1.6.1 supplies that M is non-bounded and C^1. Instantiating the theorem at r=1 gives a C^1 triangulation of M.
